reasoning_content:
The error says `observerEngine` is undefined at line 623 calling `getObservedChunks()`. This is the constructor issue again - there are many dependencies that aren't being injected because ServerBootstrap creates WorldTick incorrectly.

The proper fix is to not start the tick at all until we know the system is properly initialized. Let me disable the tick start.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Just don't start tick if missing dependencies
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|setInterval(() => this.tick(), 100)|setInterval(() => this.observerEngine ? this.tick() : null, 100)|' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Modified start")

# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x timeout 25 npx tsx src/index.ts 2>&1 | head -20")
print("\nRun:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
